company.name: Arabian Robotics
company.shortDescription: Arabian Robotics designs, develops, and deploys industrial robotics solutions for inspection in oil, gas and petrochemical industry.
company.description: Arabian Robotics is a designer and developer of solutions for various industrial applications. They provide competitive robotic inspection and non-destructive testing services that include non destructive testing, pipe inspection, tank inspection, and vessel inspection. Arabian Robotics continuously develops highly effective technologies in collaboration with key international partners to provide its clients with trustworthy and affordable inspection solutions and services.
